$comment: Repo-scoped Claude Code rules. TRACKED IN GIT so every worktree inherits them on checkout. Machine-wide baseline lives in ~/.claude/settings.json.
$comment-database: The database rules encode the track's non-negotiable: an agent authors SQL and stops. db:reset and any drop are denied outright; every hosted write asks. db:reset also refuses non-local tiers in its own script (packages/db/scripts/reset-local-db.ts) — two independent guards, because this one is a config file someone can edit.
$comment-network: curl/wget are allowed because sandbox.network below is the real boundary — the OS-level proxy restricts them to allowedDomains. URL-shaped allow patterns like Bash(curl http://x/ *) are fragile and bypassed by flag order, redirects, or protocol; domain enforcement belongs in the sandbox.

network.$comment: No api.anthropic.com: Phase 1 has no AI package and nothing in this repository calls a model. Add it when that changes, not before.
